headline: No supported positive candidate exists. A positive outcome cannot be guaranteed. Experiment 6 reached and ran an economic benchmark but produced no supported result; every other candidate route stopped before or at a measurement or feasibility gate. The observed 130 earnings events / 28 issuers is a retrieved, shape-filtered subset of a much larger Massive earnings-tag population, not the complete eligible population. TOP_100 is the fixed enrollment universe, not an empirically proven binding bottleneck, and 28 issuers is an observed filtered cohort, not a hard ceiling for the challenge strategy library.

economic_novelty.basis: No external novelty review in any artifact; protocols label all runs exploratory and already-exposed; rubric weights novelty 30 percent.

measurement_validity.interpretation: Exp9 supports an aggregate-direction claim but not event-level claims; roughly one in three closings not replicated.

source_population.question: Is 130 events / 28 issuers the complete eligible Massive population or an enrolled/retrieved subset?
observed_and_by_construction: Most of the vendor earnings-tag population (1824 accessions / 587 CIKs) sits outside the fixed universe by construction.

TOP_100 is the fixed enrollment universe: the acquisition intersects its rows with that static list, so issuers outside it are never enrolled. That is a design property of the fixed enrollment universe, not an empirical demonstration that the universe is the binding sample constraint.
The 28-issuer count is an observed, shape-filtered earnings cohort, not a hard ceiling for the challenge strategy library and not a proof about other tags, windows, or universes.
